description: This file defines interfaces and macros for MAP (Manifold Absolute Pressure) sensor processing in an engine control system. It declares functions for reading raw sensor data, converting voltage to pressure, and validating pressure readings, along with related macros for unit conversions.

methods.name: initMapDecoder
methods.description: Initializes the MAP sensor decoder with shared logging and engine parameters.

methods.name: getRawMap
methods.description: Returns the current raw MAP sensor value.

methods.name: getBaroPressure
methods.description: Returns the current barometric pressure reading.

methods.name: hasBaroSensor
methods.description: Checks if a barometric sensor is present.

methods.name: hasMapSensor
methods.description: Checks if a MAP sensor is present.

methods.name: getMap
methods.description: Returns the averaged MAP value within a measurement window.

methods.name: getMapByVoltage
methods.description: Converts voltage reading to MAP pressure value.

methods.name: decodePressure
methods.description: Decodes voltage to pressure using sensor configuration.
